root_cause: The independent verifier constructed a new ledger manifest with the current code hash before verifying a copied immutable ledger. A permission-only collector repair therefore made the verifier and service try to compare the already-open daily ledger with a new code identity, correctly producing an immutable-manifest conflict.
affected_scope: independent replay of an immutable ledger after a non-semantic code-hash transition

source_repair.read_only_open: SharedPAForwardLedger.open_existing validates the exact manifest field set, plan binding, safety booleans, expected target identities, and digest syntax without publishing or rewriting any byte.
source_repair.compatibility_boundary: A code-hash mismatch is accepted only for one exact certificate pair binding the prior collector hash and current verifier hash. Unknown hashes, duplicate pairs, widened changed paths, semantic-change claims, or evidence-byte changes fail closed.
source_repair.runtime_boundary: The 2026-07-23 AWS shared-PA runtime was restored to exact commit 7b04e8d08e1927e4ac4bbf6efad1c64392c450b9 so the already-open daily ledger cannot mix collector identities. The permission metadata repair remains applied.
